label: TheWaypoints
releaseNotes: 0.96: TheWaypoints branding, pack-only POI search, Favorites with filters, category icons, rounded clearable search, automatic paging and refined region downloads. Settings adds Stable/Beta update channels and verified APK downloads with system installation confirmation. Existing bookmarks and downloaded packs are preserved. Based on the original Waypoints idea and codebase by Vadim Sinitskiy.
